title: Easier Gunpowder
description: Custom recipe for crafting the gunpowder in version 26.2 (Using Charcoal)
body:
# Easier Gunpowder

Now that the Chaos Cubed drop has _dropped_ there is sulfur in the game!
Sulfur is one of the elements that's used to create Gunpowder in the real world.

This datapack adds a crafting recipe for the gunpowder using <font color="orange">**2 sulfur blocks**</font> and <font color="orange">**2 charcoals**</font>, making the gathering of it way <font color="orange">**Easier**</font>

![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12d32f1aad788a22664da0238a4c6841b7410203_0.webp)
